Name: (CP) Ishi no Ue ni mo San-nen
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[color=#e06666][size=6][center][quote]Even a stone will get warm if a person sits on it
for three years.[/quote][/center][/size][/color]The sales are made by Dwarf.
Limited to one per day!

[color=#ffff00][size=4]Notes.[/size][/color]
The game's specifications allow you to sit in places where you should not be sitting, but this is not a bug.
(Can sit in the air in the upper left, etc.)

English and Japanese are supported.
